name: com.coachmoshiur/daily-tonic
title: Daily Tonic by Coach Moshiur
description: Today's one-minute leadership tonic and help for hard situations, in five languages. Read-only.

tools.name: get_todays_tonic
tools.description: Today's Daily Tonic by Coach Moshiur: a short leadership and personal-growth thought, one tiny step to take today, and a question to reflect on, with a link to read it on the web.

language.description: Language: en English, bn Bangla, ar Arabic, ur Urdu, zh Chinese. Default en.

reader.description: Who the tonic is written for. Default all (everyone).

tools.name: get_recent_tonics
tools.description: The titles, tiny steps and links of the Daily Tonics of the last days (newest first).

language.description: Language: en English, bn Bangla, ar Arabic, ur Urdu, zh Chinese. Default en.

reader.description: Who the tonic is written for. Default all (everyone).

tools.name: find_situations
tools.description: Short, practical pages by Coach Moshiur for a leader with a problem today ("someone on my team keeps missing deadlines", "I have to give hard feedback", "I am exhausted and still have to lead"). Give a few words of the problem as query to search; leave query out to list the situations (of one group, or all). Each line has the title, a one-sentence summary, the key for get_situation and the link.

query.description: The problem in a few words, in the chosen language. Optional.

language.description: Language: en English, bn Bangla, ar Arabic, ur Urdu, zh Chinese. Default en.

group.description: Only this group: people (my people), boss_peers (my boss and peers), self (myself), business (my business), home_community (home and community). Optional.

tools.name: get_situation
tools.description: One situation page by Coach Moshiur as text: what to do today, words the person can use, what usually goes wrong, steps for a week, and the link. Take the key from find_situations.

key.description: The key of the situation, as find_situations gives it (for example missed_deadlines).

language.description: Language: en English, bn Bangla, ar Arabic, ur Urdu, zh Chinese. Default en.
